name: hubcode

scripts.build:daemon: npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/highlight && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/relay && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/server && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/cli
scripts.typecheck:daemon: npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/cli
scripts.build:fast: npm run build:fast:server && npm run build:fast:desktop
scripts.build:fast:server: cd packages/server && npx esbuild src/server/exports.ts src/server/index.ts --outdir=dist/server/server --platform=node --format=esm --bundle --external:ws --external:better-sqlite3 --external:pino --external:pino-pretty --external:electron-log --external:sherpa-onnx-node --external:onnxruntime-node --packages=external && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('src/terminal/shell-integration','dist/server/server/shell-integration',{recursive:true})"
scripts.build:fast:desktop: cd packages/desktop && npx esbuild src/main.ts src/preload.ts --outdir=dist --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --external:electron --external:electron-updater --external:electron-log --external:ws --external:@hubcode/server --external:@hubcode/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run build:web --workspace=@hubcode/app && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/desktop
scripts.version: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: npm run release:prepare && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/highlight && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/highlight && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/relay && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/server && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hubcode/cli && npm run build --workspace=@hubcode/cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/highlight && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/relay && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/server && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/cli
scripts.release:publish:dry-run: npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/highlight --access public && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/relay --access public && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/server --access public && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@hubcode/cli --access public
scripts.release:publish: npm publish --workspace=@hubcode/highlight --access public && npm publish --workspace=@hubcode/relay --access public && npm publish --workspace=@hubcode/server --access public && npm publish --workspace=@hubcode/cli --access public
scripts.release:rc:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:rc:patch && npm run release:push
scripts.release:rc:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:rc:minor && npm run release:push
scripts.release:rc:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:rc:major && npm run release:push
scripts.release:rc:next: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:rc:next && npm run release:push
scripts.release:promote: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:promote && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:patch && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:minor && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:major && npm run release:publish && npm run release:push

description: Hubcode: voice-controlled development environment with OpenAI Realtime API
